python3 -c "
import collections
with open('input.csv','rb') as f:
    data=f.read()
print('size',len(data))
print('CR count',data.count(b'\r'))
print('ends with newline:',data.endswith(b'\n'))
lines=data.split(b'\n')
print('num split parts',len(lines))
if lines and lines[-1]==b'': lines=lines[:-1]
print('num lines',len(lines))
c=collections.Counter(l.count(b',') for l in lines)
print('comma counts',c.most_common(20))
print('quote count lines', sum(1 for l in lines if b'\"' in l))
print('tab count lines', sum(1 for l in lines if b'\t' in l))
print('empty lines', sum(1 for l in lines if l.strip()==b''))
"

python3 -c "
with open('expected.csv','rb') as f: d=f.read()

print('lines',len(lines))
import collections

for l in lines[:5]: print(repr(l))

python3 -c "
inp=open('input.csv','rb').read().split(b'\n')
exp=open('expected.csv','rb').read().split(b'\n')
if inp[-1]==b'':inp=inp[:-1]
if exp[-1]==b'':exp=exp[:-1]
bad=0
space_inside=0
empty_field=0
for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(inp,exp)):
    parts=a.split(b',')
    if len(parts)!=3: bad+=1; continue
    st=[p.strip() for p in parts]
    if any(b' ' in x for x in st): space_inside+=1
    if any(x==b'' for x in st): empty_field+=1
    out=(b';'.join([st[2].upper(),st[1].upper(),st[0].upper()])+b';OK')
    if out!=b:
        bad+=1
        if bad<6: print('MISMATCH',i,repr(a),repr(out),repr(b))
print('bad',bad,'space_inside',space_inside,'empty',empty_field)
"

head -20 input.csv > /tmp/test.csv && cat > /tmp/t.vim <<'EOF'
call setreg('a', ":s/ //g\<CR>")
call setreg('b', ":s/\\v([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+)/\\3;\\2;\\1/\<CR>")
call setreg('c', "gUUA;OK\<Esc>")
:%normal! @a
:%normal! @b
:%normal! @c
wq
EOF
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /tmp/test.csv -S /tmp/t.vim; echo "exit=$?"; echo '--- result'; cat -A /tmp/test.csv; echo '--- expected head'; head -20 expected.csv | cat -A
